text.p: Tropical Cyclone 06B continues to weaken as it moves further inland over Bangladesh and northeast India. It is still causing heavy rain and further flooding it likely. Winds are much weaker at this time. The threat to shipping in the northern Bay of Bengal has ended.

Tropical Cyclone 05S has formed in the south Indian Ocean and is tracking to the west-southwest. Top winds are near 30-35 mph and very slow strengthening is expected. This storm is a moderate risk to shipping.
A weak tropical depression, with 25 mph winds, is causing squalls and rough seas in the Gulf of Thailand. This system should remain fairly weak as it crosses the Malay Peninsula during this period.
